summary: Step 3A (device-local notifications, web fallback) frontend testing complete. All 10 requested flows verified via Playwright on mobile viewport (375x667). No regressions in Step 2 features. TypeScript (npx tsc --noEmit) clean, no lint errors. No red screen / crash errors observed anywhere, including the web-unsupported DateTimePickerAndroid path.

react_native_issues.issue: On web, 'Choose date & time' -> tapping the date row calls DateTimePickerAndroid.open() which logs 'DateTimePickerAndroid is not supported on: web' to console. It does NOT crash the screen (silently no-ops), matching the expected/documented web limitation called out in the review request. No fix needed, informational only.

critical_code_review_comments: notifications.ts cleanly isolates expo-notifications behind isNotificationsAvailable / typed 'unavailable-on-web' error - good separation of concerns, no screen imports expo-notifications directly.
store.tsx addItemWithTrigger/setItemTrigger correctly enforce duplicate + 5-item limit checks before persisting, and removeItem/restoreItem correctly cancel/reschedule notifications to avoid orphans.

QuickAddSheet's chooseTimeOrPlace() performs duplicate + limit checks client-side before navigating to /trigger with draft params, exactly as specified - draft is never written to store until Trigger Setup confirms.
seed_data_creation: None - used dev 'Reset local data' tool between test scenarios
context_for_next_testing_agent: Step 3A fully verified on web preview: (1) Home alarm icon (outline/filled) navigates to /trigger?itemId for existing items - works. (2) Quick Add 'Choose time or place' creates a draft only, not persisted until 'Set reminder' confirmed; closing Trigger Setup (X) without confirming correctly leaves Home unaffected - verified. (3) Trigger Setup 'At a time' tab shows Later today/Tomorrow morning/Choose date & time; selecting Choose date & time on web opens the Android date-row Pressable which no-ops gracefully (console warns, no crash) since DateTimePickerAndroid is unsupported on web - this is the expected/documented limitation. (4) 'Set reminder' shows the exact expected toast 'Preview can't schedule real notifications — try this on your phone.' and still persists item+reminder (draft appears on Home with filled alarm icon + time label; editing an existing item updates its icon/label) - verified for both draft and edit paths. (5) Editing an existing time-reminder item pre-fills 'At a time' + 'Choose date & time' with existing time and shows 'Remove reminder'; tapping it clears the reminder (icon reverts to outline) and navigates back - verified. (6) Quick Add duplicate check ('Already on your list' inline, no navigation) and 5-item-limit check (closes sheet + shows Upgrade sheet, no navigation) both verified working before navigation would occur. (7) Home delete -> Undo toast -> Undo restores item WITH its reminder metadata intact (filled icon + time label reappeared) - verified, no crash. (8) Settings dev tools 'Send test notification (10s)' shows honest toast 'Notifications need a real device — not available in this preview' on web, never claims success - verified. (9) Regression: Routines screen, Forgot Something screen, FREE/PRO dev toggle all load and function correctly with no changes from Step 2. All flows tested with fresh reset-local-data state; each browser_automation call spins a fresh browser context so state does not persist between separate tool calls (expected, not a bug) - just something to note for anyone re-running tests in this environment.
